g.font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: slide the filter over the input, multiply element-wise, and sum into one number
The top-left window, step by step
middle column: weights are 0, so it adds 0
A 3×3 filter has exactly 4×4 positions that fit inside a 6×6 input, which is why the output is 4×4: n − f + 1 = 6 − 3 + 1 = 4.
